links.comparator_used: Same 14 LLMs answering without RAG (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Accuracy (percent correct) on 449 ACCSAP cardiology board-style multiple-choice questions
links.effect: All models improved after RAG using a 123-document guideline and textbook knowledge base; e.g., Mistral Large 2 reached 78.0% (95% CI: 73.9-81.5) with RAG, comparable to GPT 4o. RAG was reported as particularly beneficial for smaller models.
links.quote: After RAG, all models improved, and open-weight models like Mistral Large 2 (78.0%, 95% CI: 73.9-81.5) performed comparably to proprietary alternatives like GPT 4o.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (RAG) with guideline and textbook knowledge base
